Core structural grid: x=4.00+3.00=7.00, y=3.50+2.00+4.00=9.50. This is the cleanest/least cluttered read of the main structural grid.

pattern_plan_pages.note: Beam plan. Shows the same core grid as S-02 PLUS a dummy-grid extension: x-axis +1.50 m beyond grid 3, y-axis +1.50+1.50=3.00 m below grid A. Beams B4X/CN/B3X/B5X/ST bear on these extension points (genuine beam endpoints per schema §4 beam-endpoint rule), so Stage 1 must add dummy grid lines there (e.g. 3' on x, A'/A'' on y) — not slab-only edges.

pattern_plan_pages.note: อะเส (ring beam) plan uses the same core 1/2/3 x A/B/C/D grid as S-02/S-03 (B2 members only, no extension shown here). Roof truss plan additionally prints 1.00 m eave-overhang dimensions on all 4 sides — FLAGGED: not yet confirmed whether these overhang edges are dummy structural grid lines (columns/beams there) or slab/eave-only lines with no beam endpoint; roof members shown (อกไก่, จันทัน, ตะเฆ่สัน) are steel C-channel, need Stage 1 to check if any land exactly on the 1.00 m overhang line.

grid_master_source_sheet.reasoning: README precedence rule: grid geometry is won by STRUCTURAL S-sheets, and A-03 (ผังบริเวณ, site plan) explicitly self-declares 'เป็นเพียงตัวอย่างเพื่อประมาณราคา' in its own หมายเหตุ — per the README this self-declaration means A-03 never overrides the S-sheets even though its numbers currently agree (11.70 total width close to core 7.00 + margins, 14.60 total depth vs core 9.50 + margins - not an exact match, likely includes eave/setback, so treat as non-authoritative).
grid_master_source_sheet.flag: S-02 alone only shows the clean 3x4 core grid (7.00 x 9.50). S-03 (หน้า20) is required too, to pick up the dummy-grid extension serving B3X/B4X/B5X/ST/CN, which S-02's footing layout does not show (no footing was drawn at that extension - possible slab-on-grade there, needs Stage 1 to check S-05/S-06 footing details for a footing mark at that location before assuming no footing exists). Start Stage 1 from S-02 for the named grid, then reconcile against S-03 for the dummy extension before finalizing หน้า00_gridline.json.

flags_and_ambiguities: SN (sanitary), EE (electrical), M (mechanical) disciplines: only 1 page sampled from each (SN-02 = general notes/text only; EE-02 = load-center riser/panel schedule diagram, not a floor layout). Neither sampled page qualifies as pattern:plan. Not exhaustively checked page-by-page — if any SN/EE/M sheet turns out to be a piping/wiring floor layout with grid_ref, Stage 2 should reclassify it as plan when encountered.

BOQ page ranges (ฐานรากแผ่: png40-49, ฐานรากเสาเข็ม: png50-59) and the หลักเกณฑ์ note pages (png60-62) were derived arithmetically from the สารบัญ + confirmed offset, not opened individually — low risk since the offset was verified consistent at 5 points spanning the whole document, but Stage 1/2 should do a quick sanity check on the first page of each BOQ block (png40, png50) to confirm sheet_code before bulk-extracting.

S-04's roof-plan 1.00 m eave overhang dimension chain is NOT yet resolved as dummy-grid-worthy or not (see pattern_plan_pages note above) - explicit open question for Stage 1, not silently decided here.

A-03 (site plan, png05) is pattern:site_plan and is per-README non-authoritative for grid geometry (self-declared 'ตัวอย่างเพื่อประมาณราคา') - recorded here so Stage 1/2/3 do not accidentally treat its 11.70/14.60 overall dimensions as the structural grid closure target; the closure target is the S-sheet core+dummy chain instead.
